mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% signals economic distress and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply-side shock that increases production costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A robust labor market, indicated by employment levels above 130,000 thousand (PAYEMS), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in employment below 130,000 thousand (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness and reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS falls below 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% and UNRATE falls by more than 0.3% from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle, indicated by federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS), increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.
